annotations.title: Get a Strategy Lab's status and result

description: Returns where a Strategy Lab stands - waiting for the rule card, waiting for the user's check, queued, running, done or watching forward - with the place in the queue, a rough wait, and once tested the verdict and its reason. Use it when the user asks how their test is going. It changes nothing in the lab; a look counts as a visit, which keeps the lab for 12 more months.

lab.description: The private lab link from test_strategy_code or from a TrueTest email (https://truetest.uk/lab/...), or its 32-character code; 'demo' for the public sample lab
lab.title: Lab

name: get_lab_status

backtest_note.description: PROMISING only: it is a backtest
backtest_note.title: Backtest Note

does_not_show.description: what the verdict does not cover (shown together with shows)
does_not_show.title: Does Not Show

context.description: the points are true facts from the record and do not change the verdict
context.title: Context

points.description: up to 3 things the record does well, computed from its trades; they come after the verdict and never replace it
points.title: Points

warning.description: grid / martingale records: why the good-looking numbers are a known risk shape
warning.title: Warning

what_if.description: at most 1 what-if on the same trades (a smaller risk, a drawdown stop); hindsight, never a forecast
what_if.title: What If

what_if_note.description: the condition that belongs with the what-if
what_if_note.title: What If Note

scope.description: how the versions behind the luck bar were counted
scope.title: Scope

cost_estimate.description: present when the costs of some tested symbols are an estimate not yet checked against live prices: which ones
cost_estimate.title: Cost Estimate

evidence_scope.description: once tested: what the result shows and does not show

good_points.description: once tested: what the rebuilt strategy does well; it follows the verdict

kept_at_least_until.description: a customer lab: the UTC date (yyyy-mm-dd) until which it is kept at least, under the current policy
kept_at_least_until.title: Kept At Least Until

kept_note.description: how long the lab is kept and what moves that date on
kept_note.title: Kept Note

queue_length.description: queued or running: labs in the queue
queue_length.title: Queue Length

rebuild.description: present when the rebuild is not exact

rough_wait_minutes.description: queued or running: a rough wait
rough_wait_minutes.title: Rough Wait Minutes

sample.description: present only for the public sample lab
sample.title: Sample

worst_day.description: info only: the largest daily loss, for scale
worst_day.title: Worst Day
